top_signals.title: State Street Sees Resilience Driving Portfolios (Correct)
top_signals.summary:
State Street Investment Management CEO Yie-Hsin Hung says investors have entered an era where resilient portfolios are increasingly important as higher capital costs, geopolitical tensions and technological change create a wider range of potential outcomes. Hung tells Bloomberg This Weekend hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that institutional investors are adding liquidity and other portfolio buffers, while State Street is also expanding access to private markets and providing the default ETF for the US government's Trump Accounts program. They speak at the 2026 Qatar Economic Forum, UNGA Special Edition; Powered by Bloomberg.
(Corrects title of guest in graphic) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
